A [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''police detective''' served the local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. 

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], the tough-talking [[Detective/Legends|detective]] investigated a chaotic [[speeder/Legends|speeder]] chase in the roads of [[Drev'starn]]. Witnesses tentatively identified some of the participants as several [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[operative]]s who were staying in a [[Bothan hotel]].

He arrived right when they found their room ransacked; after threatening to take them for questioning, he asked a few things, commenting on the condition of that room. Nobody knew that a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Unidentified Rodian partner|criminal]] was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] at that place shortly earlier.

Eventually with their help, they apprehended the Rodian's partner, a [[Unidentified crime syndicate courier|courier]] working for a local crime syndicate.
==Personality and traits==
The detective was gruff, and was not above stealing some [[fruit/Legends|fruits]] from a service cart when nobody was looking. He attempted to play tough and clever.
==Behind the scenes==
The game scenario allows some choices about the detective's involvement in the murder case; the Rebel players notice the dead Rodian first, and is up to them whether they mention it to the detective, or distract/get rid of him (by asking him for a warrant or to press charges). If the detective is aware of the body, he will tag along in order to be led to the culprit.
